cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.51% · WTI -0.65% · Brent -1.47% · NatGas +0.98%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +6.13%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.13%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.15%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +9.74%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +9.74%, BE +8.89%, TLN +8.82%, ENPH +7.29%, ETN +6.49%. Laggards: MPC -2.79%, FANG -2.58%, MPLX -2.51%, APA -2.43%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
